citations.assessment: The unit expressly names Rabban Gamliel son of Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi. The explanation for the title and date of insertion is attributed rather than stated by the Mishnah.
Abarbanel gives both alternatives, that the title was added after succession or that the unit was added later.
The named local notice distinguishes the lineages and their chronology. It does not independently prove a post-Rabbi interpolation.
Rabbi appoints the wise Shimon separately from Gamliel the patriarch. In the concluding scene, Rabbi explicitly asks for his eldest and Gamliel enters.
The separate entry states the same relative birth order and wisdom.
The passage attests the formula but leaves the speaker anonymous.
The Rav Safra entry identifies the anonymous figure differently, as R. N. Berabbi, and lists other versions of the house in question. Preserve the contradiction.
Rabbi Yochanan speaks to Gamliel, son of Rabbi, who keeps his food in a state of purity.
The compassion maxim is said by Gamliel Berabbi. The epithet alone does not decide the identity.
The previous entry discusses the inheritance of this title and its separate honorific use.
The barrel test is attributed to Gamliel son of Rabbi. The nearby Dorqati case is assigned to the Elder.
The land comparison is attributed to Rabban Gamliel bar Rabbi.
The Yehudah entry makes this relationship explicit.
The named Hillel entry makes him the son of Yehudah Nesia. Preserve the shorter sentence’s syntactic ambiguity in the research note.
Heilprin repeats and rejects the intercalation attribution and the last three names. His substitute preserves Gamliel son of Rabbi and names Hillel son of Yehudah Nesia.
The explicit pointer goes to the elder Shimon article.
